content.text:
Super common at 28 months, since a lot of toddlers get wary of green food around now. Try putting a tiny bit of something green on his plate next to a food he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Let him touch it, smell it, or ignore it. Kids often need many calm exposures before they taste it, so keep serving it and don't push. Letting him help wash or tear the spinach or broccoli can make it feel less strange.

One more thing: I can try signing him up for a class on its registration page if you say yes. I told you earlier that I couldn't, and that was wrong.
